children: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance has recorded a 68.96 per cent year-on-year growth in its retail protection (term plan) business in Keralam in Q1 FY27, covering 8.30 lakh lives in the State as of March 31.

The insurer’s assets under management (AUM) in Keralam stood at ₹12,922 crore as of March 31, while the sum assured was ₹63,394 crore. Over the past seven years, the company has paid total benefits of ₹2,773 crore to customers in the State, including ₹356 crore in death claims.
ICICI Prudential Life has 31 branches and 20,008 advisors in Keralam, supported by 6,217 partner branches and 2,865 specified persons.
Manikandan Rajamani, Chief of Distribution, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, said the company was witnessing strong momentum across both urban and emerging centres in the State.

“Over the past few quarters, we have seen a clear shift in customer behaviour, with individuals increasingly prioritising financial protection, long-term savings and retirement planning as part of their overall financial goals,” he said.

The company reported a claim settlement ratio of 99.3 per cent in Q1 FY27, with an average turnaround time of one day for non-investigated individual claims at the overall company level. Its early claims ratio stood at 22 pert cent, which the company described as best in class in the industry.

“Keralam offers significant long-term opportunities and we remain committed to expanding our reach, improving accessibility and delivering solutions that address the evolving needs of customers across the State,” Rajamani said.
The company plans to further strengthen its presence in Keralam through branch expansion, advisor hiring and targeted customer outreach initiatives, he added.

title: ICICI Prudential Life sees 69% growth in retail protection business in Keralam
